# About VNPT and VNPT Technology

## How VNPT Group and VNPT Technology differ
<!-- id: vnpt.en.group | facts: vnpt.group, vnpt.member | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §1 (slide 2) | aliases: what is VNPT, VNPT Group, what is VNPT Technology, member companies | say_for: define,compare | say: VNPT is Vietnam's leading state-owned telecom group; VNPT Technology is one member company of the Group. -->
VNPT is a state-owned enterprise and the leading provider of telecommunications, information technology and communications in Vietnam. VNPT Technology is one member company of the Group, alongside units such as VNPT NET, VNPT VinaPhone, VNPT Media and VNPT IT. The research, manufacturing and product information here belongs to VNPT Technology, not to the Group as a whole.

## What VNPT Technology does
<!-- id: vnpt.en.tech | facts: vnpt.tech.role, vnpt.tech.founded | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §2 (slide 3) | aliases: vnpt technology, vnpt tech, electronics research and manufacturing | say_for: define | say: VNPT Technology is the VNPT Group's driving force in research, design and manufacturing of electronic products in Vietnam, founded in January 2011. -->
According to the company profile, VNPT Technology is the VNPT Group's driving force in research, design and manufacturing of electronic products in Vietnam, founded in January 2011. Its subsidiaries are ANSV, VIVAS and TELEQ. Figures such as headcount, output or revenue change over time and are not given here; check the latest official source.

## Three main activities
<!-- id: vnpt.en.activities | facts: vnpt.tech.activities | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §4 (slide 5) | aliases: business areas, activities, digital transformation, system integration | say_for: define | say: VNPT Technology works in three areas: research and development, system integration and digital transformation, and electronics manufacturing. -->
VNPT Technology works in three areas: research and development (hardware and firmware design, carrier-grade software platforms, and R&D as a service); system integration and digital transformation (network and IT infrastructure, security, digital transformation solutions); and electronics manufacturing (PCBA assembly, measurement and calibration, and telecom equipment such as Wi-Fi and xPON).

## Research and design capability
<!-- id: vnpt.en.rnd | facts: vnpt.tech.rnd | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §5, §9 (slides 6-9, 16) | aliases: R&D, research and development, hardware design, firmware, antenna, ODM | say_for: define | say: VNPT Technology designs hardware, firmware and embedded software, and industrial and mechanical parts in-house, as ODM, OEM and JDM. -->
The company designs in-house: hardware (schematics, multilayer PCBs, high-speed design, RF for cellular and Wi-Fi 4/5/6/7, antennas, GPON/XGS-PON optical devices), firmware and embedded software (on Qualcomm, Broadcom, MediaTek/Airoha and Realtek platforms; operating systems such as OpenWrt), and industrial and mechanical design. Engagement models are ODM, OEM and JDM. Technology areas named: 5G, IoT, fixed broadband, wireless broadband and digital transformation.

## Product groups
<!-- id: vnpt.en.products | facts: vnpt.tech.products | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §6 (slide 12) | aliases: vnpt products, vnpt devices, ONT, mesh, wifi 7, set-top box, camera | say_for: define | say: VNPT Technology's products are optical network terminals, Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 7 mesh systems, Wi-Fi access points, set-top boxes, IoT gateways and IP cameras. -->
According to the company profile, VNPT Technology's product groups are: optical network terminals (ONT, GPON and XGS-PON), Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 7 mesh systems, Wi-Fi access points, set-top boxes, IoT gateways and IP cameras. Specifications of a given model must come from that model's own documents, not be inferred from another model.

## Cooperation with Qualcomm
<!-- id: vnpt.en.qualcomm | facts: vnpt.qcom | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §7 (slides 13-14) | aliases: qualcomm, qualcomm cooperation, excellence center, qualcomm platform | say_for: define | say: VNPT Technology signed a patent licence agreement with Qualcomm in 2017 and launched the VNPT-Qualcomm Excellence Center in 2025. -->
The company profile records that VNPT Technology signed a patent licence agreement with Qualcomm in 2017 and launched the VNPT-Qualcomm Excellence Center in 2025. Several of its models are in mass production on Qualcomm silicon, from Wi-Fi 5 to Wi-Fi 7, including XGS-PON ONTs, mesh systems, enterprise access points and a mobile Wi-Fi hotspot.

## Manufacturing and quality
<!-- id: vnpt.en.manufacturing | facts: vnpt.tech.factory, vnpt.tech.certs | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §2, §11 (slides 3, 18-23) | aliases: factory, manufacturing, certificates, ISO, quality | say_for: define | say: The company runs factories in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, with certificates such as ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015. -->
The profile states that the company runs factories in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City with SMT, DIP and assembly lines, a manufacturing execution system (MES) on its own platform, and quality control from suppliers to final inspection. Certificates listed: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, TL 9000, RBA, ANSI/ESD S20.20 and IPC-A-610. Capacity figures are those of the time the profile was written.

## Markets and contact
<!-- id: vnpt.en.markets | facts: vnpt.tech.markets, vnpt.tech.contact | src: docs/vnpt_technology_company_profile.md §3, contact line (slide 4) | aliases: markets, export, countries, contact, website | say_for: define | say: VNPT Technology's products are sold in Vietnam, the USA, Mexico, Chile, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Korea, Japan and more; website: www.vnpt-technology.vn. -->
According to the company profile, VNPT Technology's products are present in markets including Vietnam, the USA, Mexico, Chile, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, Myanmar, Malaysia, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Korea and Japan. Official website: www.vnpt-technology.vn.
